repairs.contractRationale: Set stores approved Unicode-15.1-White_Space-edge-trimmed text without numeric canonicalization, preserving interior and excluded characters. Relative operations use current ASCII whole-string decimal text, arbitrary signed precision and existing byte bounds. Zero delta changes no numeric component, so it must not canonicalize +0009 or -0 or manufacture a mutation; unusable symbolic text still rejects. Gameplay life now uses TableActions.trimText and its bounded arithmetic wrapper. TableActions.addNumber delegates to the retained exact GameplayNumbers implementation rather than maintaining two independent arithmetic implementations; player-counter and turn-number affected checks also execute. No machine integer conversion, clamp or truncation was introduced.
